mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the foreign shareholder passport or national identity document
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent passport/identity authority of the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney appointing the Colombian incorporation representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or competent company registrar of the shareholder's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, Interpol corridors, Colombian national sanction lists issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and domestic financial-intelligence watchlists. PEP screening against high-public-office holders, close associates, and family members is required under Circular 045 of 2017 and UIAF guidelines, with enhanced due diligence where any risk match appears. For foreign investors, PAL (Persona Expuesta Políticamente) scrutiny applies to foreign public officials.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Cámaras de Comercio via Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) – www.rues.org.co / Bogotá Chamber of Commerce – www.ccb.org.co
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Spanish or in a form that can be expressed in Spanish characters; the name must be followed by 'S.A.S.' for SAS entities. No exact or confusingly similar name may be registered. Accents, diacritics, and numerals are admissible if they do not generate false identity; transliteration into Spanish script is required for foreign-origin names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a reconsideration request before the same Chamber of Commerce within ten business days, accompanied by amended name proposals. If the Chamber upholds the rejection, an administrative appeal may be submitted to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) under Law 1437 of 2011, within ten business days of notification of the reconsideration decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the instant rice noodle manufacturing industry. The Colombian Commercial Code and INVIMA food-sanitation regulations require a physical registered establishment with appropriate industrial zoning, sanitary infrastructure, and production capacity. A virtual office may not serve as the registered legal domicile for a manufacturing SAS.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 75% annual probability of unannounced physical inspection once INVIMA registration and municipal operating permits are issued; food manufacturing premises are subject to periodic and spot sanitary checks.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 2, 5, 17 and 23; complemented by the Colombian Commercial Code (Código de Comercio), Articles 110-112.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio local (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), supervised by the Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento de Constitución y Estatutos (Private Incorporation Instrument and Bylaws)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital for S.A.S.; at least one share must be subscribed. Payment may be deferred as set out in the bylaws; no escrow account or bank deposit is required for incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the corporation is duly incorporated and that the subscription of shares by the incorporators, as set forth in the bylaws, is hereby ratified and accepted. RESOLVED, that the registered office located at [address] is adopted for statutory and administrative purposes, and that the legal representative is authorized to file all registration and licensing documents. RESOLVED, that [Name], as Chief Executive Officer, and [Name], as Chief Financial Officer, are appointed to manage the business and to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and obtain permits on behalf of the corporation. All resolutions are adopted unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio via RUES (Registro Único Empresarial) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a certificate of homonymy (certificado de homonimia) to confirm the requested company name is available. Submit at least three name alternatives through the RUES platform and pay the nominal search fee.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney, if acting through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If homonymy is found, modify the proposed name and resubmit; or file a written appeal to the Cámara de Comercio within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of SAS Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría (if notarization is required) or directly with the Cámara de Comercio when executed by private instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the incorporation contract and bylaws containing the corporate purpose, share structure, registered office, governance rules, and officer powers. Execute before a notary if real property is contributed; otherwise, sign as a private document.
required_dossiers: Identification documents of shareholders and incorporators
Proof of registered office location (lease or title)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any legal defects noted by the Cámara de Comercio in a written observation and resubmit the amended instrument within fifteen business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Registration with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (via RUES online platform)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument, pay the registration tax and processing fee, and obtain the certificate of incorporation and the NIT preliminary number. This completes enrollment in the Mercantile Registry.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registration taxes
Completed RUES form (including economic activity CIIU 1079)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry files an objection, respond in writing with clarifications or amended documents; registration is perfected once the observation is cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Cámara de Comercio provides the NIT, update the RUT through the DIAN electronic portal. Assign the main national economic activity code 1079 (Manufacture of other food products n.e.c.) and register the legal representative as the responsible party.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and legal representation
Proof of factory or warehouse address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of DIAN rejection, correct the CIIU code or supporting documentation and resubmit within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of Officers and Workplace with Social Security
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AFP/ARL (Pension and Occupational Risk Funds) and Caja de Compensación (Family Compensation Fund)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the legal representative and all employees in the integrated payroll settlement system (SALUD, ARL, Caja de Compensación). Enroll the manufacturing plant with an ARL to obtain occupational hazard insurance prior to startup.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration discrepancies occur, correct the payroll data in the PILA system and resubmit to the ARL and Caja de Compensación without delay.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA (Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Sanitary Registration of Food Products (Registro Sanitario) and Manufacturing Plant Sanitary Authorization (Autorización Sanitaria de Planta)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ANLA (Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales) or the regional autonomous environmental corporation (CAR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II – low to moderate environmental impact. A simplified environmental registration is normally sufficient for instant rice noodle manufacturing; a full EIA is required only if daily wastewater discharge exceeds 10 m³/day or if the process emits significant air pollutants from frying or drying operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must comply with Resolution 0631 of 2015 (national parameter limits: BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, COD ≤ 600 mg/L, TSS ≤ 150 mg/L, pH 6–9). Air emissions must meet Resolution 909 of 2008 (PM10 ≤ 50 µg/m³, VOC ≤ 200 mg/m³). Solid waste handling follows Resolution 2184 of 2019.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the municipal Fire Department (Cuerpo de Bomberos); structural load inspection and occupancy permit from the Municipal Planning Office (Curaduría Urbana); occupational health and safety workplace clearance verified by the ARL and the District Health Secretary for food handling areas.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — official website: https://www.dian.gov.co; operational portal: MUISCA (https://muisca.dian.gov.co), including the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) subsystem.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Colombian S.A.S. must register with DIAN before commencing taxable operations. The procedure is: (i) incorporate the S.A.S. before a notary and register it with the local Chamber of Commerce, (ii) obtain digital signature (firma electrónica) for its legal representative, (iii) apply for RUT inscription (inscripción en el RUT) through the MUISCA portal or a DIAN service center, submitting the certificate of existence, the bylaws, and an apostilled/power-of-attorney for foreign shareholders or administrators, appointing a Colombian legal representative for tax purposes as applicable, and (iv) receive the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), which is the single statutory tax identification number. VAT registration as responsable del IVA and withholding-agent registration are contained in the same RUT/NIT profile.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or foreign hybrid classification election exists under Colombian domestic law. The S.A.S. is mandatorily taxed at entity level as a resident corporation on its worldwide income. The only material elective option relevant to this manufacturing scope is the optional ‘Régimen Simple de Tributación’ (SIMPLES) for eligible very small taxpayers; no hybrid mismatch bunching/subpart F style elections are available to foreign shareholders.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No Colombian peso turnover threshold applies. Every legal entity carrying out taxable acts such as selling goods, producing or importing taxable food products, or rendering services must register in the RUT/NIT as responsable de IVA before commencing operations; registration is unconditional for a commercial manufacturer regardless of annual gross receipts.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta) is required for all S.A.S. commercial taxpayers. Invoices must be generated in XML with a unique CUF (Código Único de Facturación), an embedded QR code, and sent in real time to DIAN’s online validation and clearance services (MUISCA / authorized electronic invoicing platform). DIAN processes the document at the moment of transmission; acceptance, rejection or error staging is returned digitally. Physical dry stamps are no longer used; proof of VAT treatment is the DIAN-validated XML and corresponding acknowledgement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods qualify for the zero rating/exclusion from Colombian IVA when: (i) the S.A.S. is registered as an exporter in the RUT; (ii) the goods are sold to a foreign buyer and physically leave Colombian customs territory; (iii) the corresponding export declaration (DAE) is presented and accepted through DIAN’s customs systems; (iv) the export invoice identifies the foreign customer and states the export destination; and (v) the export proceeds are channeled through and settled in the Colombian foreign exchange market within the legal term. Input VAT borne on export-oriented production is creditable; excess credits may be refunded after DIAN review.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAE – Declaración de Exportación)
Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document evidencing physical departure from Colombian customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate / foreign exchange settlement evidence issued by the Colombian intermediary bank
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN performs substantive audit verification of export invoices, customs declarations, physical shipment evidence and FX settlement. Fraudulent or improperly substantiated export zero-rating followed by an input VAT refund triggers: (i) mandatory retrospective clawback of the refunded amount with updated default interest; (ii) monetary penalties of up to 100% of the inaccurately claimed excess refund under the Colombian Tax Code; (iii) suspension, linked-benefits denial or cancellation of the exporter RUT status; and (iv) criminal tax fraud exposure under the Colombian Tax Code Article 647 and contraband-related prosecutions when forged customs documentation is used. The ordinary statutory prescription period for DIAN to assess and recollect is 5 taxable years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (including the Comisión de Cambios for foreign exchange regulation)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed-float foreign exchange regime. Current-account transactions are substantially convertible, but capital-account operations, including foreign direct investment and cross-border financing, must be channelled through authorized financial intermediaries and registered with Banco de la República. Profit and dividend remittances from a Colombian S.A.S. are legally permitted once the relevant corporate tax obligations, annual registrations, and foreign-exchange declarations are duly filed, and the investment has been properly registered in the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Decree 1735 of 1993, exporters of goods must channel the full invoice value of their proceeds through the Colombian foreign exchange market within six (6) months from the date of shipment. There is no stipulation of partial surrender; the proceeds must be repatriated or placed in an authorized local foreign-currency compensation account (cuenta de compensación) before conversion to Colombian pesos. Each collection is evidenced by the corresponding foreign-exchange declaration and linked to the customs export declaration (DEX/DUS).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Multi-Currency (USD/COP) Account
Capital Escrow Account and Operational Current Account in COP with USD Clearing Venue
Operational Current Account and Foreign Investment Restricted Account
Operational Account and Trade Settlement Account
Operational Account and Peso Clearing Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-conditioned feasibility. Non-resident digital electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as global fintech payment platforms are not authorised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia and cannot hold local COP-currency accounts, provide domestic clearing, or issue local IBAN-type routing codes. They may support off-shore treasury layers by executing cross-border supplier payments outside Colombia, but all statutory cash flows, payroll, tax payments, and regulated capital injections must pass through a locally licenced financial intermediary. Feasibility rating: Low for domestic treasury, Medium as an ancillary cross-border disbursement rail for low-value overseas supplier payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For opening a treasury account in Colombia, the S.A.S. legal representative (or a person with sufficient representation power under the corporate bylaws) must appear physically before the bank's compliance officer. Non-resident directors are not automatically excused; if they cannot appear, a lawful apoderado general must be appointed through a notarised and apostilled Power of Attorney. In practice, new corporate clients undergo an in-person due diligence interview at the bank's offices, and the bank reserves the right to conduct a site visit of the manufacturing facility. Remote opening is only feasible for existing institutional clients with a pre-existing banking record in the same financial institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear or multi-layered UBO chain without evident economic nexus in Colombia
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised UBO declaration, complete share-transfer chain from Cámara de Comercio, notarised passports or civil IDs of all ultimate owners, certified corporate bylaws and board minutes resolving the account opening, and a written business narrative confirming Colombian operational substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Manufacturing profile inconsistent with raw-material import flows or commodity volumes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Customs import declaration (DUAs), supplier invoices and purchase contracts, warehouse leases or property titles for the plant, machinery purchase receipts, inventory records, and INVIMA sanitary registration for instant rice noodle products.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions-sensitive or high-risk offshore counterparties in payment flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated OFAC, UN, and EU sanctions screening summary showing nil hits, certificates of origin, end-beneficiary declarations, detailed commercial contracts with Incoterms, and a legal justification of the legitimate business purpose and geographical routing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Early request for credit facilities, invoice factoring, or unusual transaction velocity before reliable operating history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: At least two fiscal years of audited (or interim reviewed) financial statements, VAT and income tax returns filed with DIAN, payroll and social security filings, insurance policies, cash-flow forecasts, and documented purchase orders supporting genuine commercial operations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions from non-resident shareholders must be remitted by SWIFT MT103 to an account held with an authorised Colombian commercial bank. The remittance instructions must include the S.A.S. tax ID (NIT), the legal name of the investee, and the foreign investment registration number assigned by Banco de la República. The bank will receive the funds, verify the underlying board/shareholders' resolution approving the capital increase, collect the mandatory foreign-exchange declaration, and credit the capital escrow account. The foreign investment must be registered under Banco de la República's Registro de Inversiones Internacionales before the funds are used for working capital or trade disbursements, utilising the applicable concept code for direct foreign investment in Colombia.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements to overseas raw-material suppliers will use SWIFT MT103 for telegraphic transfers and documentary commercial letters of credit (SWIFT MT700/MT707) for large import consignments, particularly where phytosanitary certificates and pre-shipment inspection are warranted. Domestic peso clearing for suppliers in Colombia should run via the local ACH (ACH Colombia) or the CUD high-value cheque and electronic clearing system offered by Banco de la República. A dedicated trade settlement account in USD may be maintained with the same local bank to reduce conversion costs and accelerate documentary checks.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable and non-deliverable USD-COP forward contracts (forwards) executed with licensed Colombian financial intermediaries subject to Banco de la República's foreign exchange oversight.
Cross-currency swaps (USD-COP) for rolling hedges of contracted capital flows and trade-related liabilities
Plain-vanilla OTC options on USD-COP for hedging flag-ship rice noodle export or raw-material import exposures

Offshore COP non-deliverable forwards used by foreign counterparties or treasury centres, structured only when the Colombian operating entity maintains an evidenced underlying exposure and the intermediary is a supervised financial institution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of Commercial Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce of registered seat, e.g., Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually no later than 31 March; renewal preserves the original registration anniversary for the entire calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Financial penalties up to 17 SMMLV (COP 24,199,500 ≈ USD 5,700) under Código de Comercio Art. 86; continued non-renewal for more than one year may lead to suspension of the commercial registration, strike-off from Chamber records, and loss of access to foreign trade and banking transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ordinary Shareholders' Meeting and Deposit of Approved Financial Statements (Asamblea General Ordinaria y depósito de estados financieros)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate minute book; Cámara de Comercio for financial statement deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Meeting to be held by 31 March (within three months after the 31 December fiscal year-end); deposit with the Chamber within one month after approval, generally by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Without approved and deposited financial statements, dividends are legally undistributable and shareholder resolutions may be challenged; directors incur civil liability, and Chamber/DIAN may apply fines up to COP 142,350,000 (100 SMMLV ≈ USD 33,500) for omitted or late deposit.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta anual)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For the preceding fiscal year, filing window between early August and late October (example: 9 August – 29 October), assigned by the last two digits of the NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine of 5% of tax due per month or fraction, capped at 100% of tax; moratory interest of 1.5% per month for unpaid tax; if no tax is due, penalty of 0.5% of gross income (capped); persistent non-filing exposes the company to DIAN official assessment, asset seizure, NIT suspension, and inclusion on the default taxpayer list.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Informational Return / Magneto-magnetic filing (Información Exógena)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for the previous taxable year, per the DIAN resolution schedule (generally mid-May to 30 June)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Article 651 ET up to COP 29,000,000 (≈ USD 6,800) for non-filing or misstatement; correction after the deadline reduces the penalty but does not extinguish it; repeated defaults may lead to broader tax audit scrutiny.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner Confirmation (Reporte de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN UBO register (information shared with UIAF Financial Intelligence Unit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 1 July covering the preceding calendar year; any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership must be reported within 30 days of the transfer being recorded in the share register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Article 651 ET up to COP 29,000,000 (≈ USD 6,800) for omission, incomplete data, or false declaration; false UBO statements may additionally trigger tax fraud liability and enhanced AML risk rating.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is compulsory if gross assets or gross annual income on the preceding 31 December exceed 5,000 current monthly minimum wages (SMMLV; COP 7,117,500,000 ≈ USD 1.67 million for 2025), or if the company has more than 200 employees; appointment is also required when the articles of association so stipulate or when the company receives public funds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Grupo 2 – NIF para Pymes (Colombian local GAAP converged with IFRS for SMEs) under Decreto 2420 de 2015 and Decreto 2496 de 2015; full IFRS (Grupo 1) only if the S.A.S. becomes a public-interest entity, exceeds asset and workforce thresholds (assets over 30,000 SMMLV and more than 200 employees), or voluntarily opts in.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: By 1 July of each year the legal representative must certify through the DIAN UBO module the identity, tax residence, and percentage of economic rights and control of every ultimate beneficiary holding or controlling 5% or more, directly or indirectly, or exercising de facto control. Share transfers recorded in the share register during the year require a supplementary UBO update within 30 days; the annual confirmation must reconcile the UBO report with the final shareholding structure at 31 December and be supported by the updated shareholder register.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – 1,500 per year for registered office, Chamber liaison and local corporate agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – 6,500 per year for a statutory Revisor Fiscal or voluntary certified audit by a Colombian CPA firm
